name: smwgraphics-smwc3-and-mosts-trophy-badges
title: SMWC3 and Mosts Trophy Badges
description:
Ripped into SMW for in-game use.
You can re-colour them as you see fit, or swap palettes to mess with players.

Mosts and C3 trophies were made by anonymous users.

(There are two versions of the silver trophy: one as it is on the website, and one with the little star on top fixed so it's centered.)
